title: Josiah Frazier and drum lessons
summary: Eddie names Josiah Frazier; the interviewer took a few drum lessons from him. Eddie calls him among the best drummers, with Louis Barbarin.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Josiah Frasier. Yeah. You know me? Yeah. Toyscudden. Paul Bowen. Paul Bowen. That's not Poyscudden.
When I was little, I took some lessons from Saeed, Frasier. He did. Not many, but I didn't stick with it.
You say he took a few drum lessons from Saeed when he was there.
Yeah, when I was little. Well, he's about the best one out there now. Uh-huh. Him and Barberman, Louie Barberman. Uh-huh. And all the two real old ones, Louie and Josiah. They are drummers.
Let him know what you're interested mostly in. One of them, yeah.
Josiah is pretty good. You know? He's a good drummer.
